content: Dawiti Ola Asaa Qoodida Qoodo
Qasseka GODAY Isra7eele asaa bolla keehi hanqettides; istta bolla Dawite denththeththidi, «Ba! Isra7eele asaanne Yuhuda asaa qooda!» gides.

Hessa gishshas kawozi Iyo7aabenne izara diza ola asaa azazizayta, «Daaneppe biidi Bersaabehe gakkanaas diza Isra7eele qommota ubbatakko biite; istta qooday ay keena gididaakko nu erana mala ola asata mazgabite» gides.
Iyo7aabey kawozas, «GODAA ne Xoossay ola asaa xeetu kushe darso; ta godaa kawo ayfey hessa gakki beyo; gido attiin ta godaa kawoy hessaththo ooththanaas ays koyidee?» gides.
Gidikkoka kawoza qaalay Iyo7aabenne ola asaa azazizayta xoonida gishshas Isra7eele ola asaa mazgabanaas iza sinththafe kezi bida.
Istti Yordaanoose shaafa pinnidaappe guye shoobbaza giddon diza katamaappe dugeha baggara diza Aaro7eere matan dunkaanida; heeppeka Gaade baggara aadhdhi Iyaazeere bida.
Heeppe Gala7aadenne Hiite deren diza Qaadeese asaakko bida; qasse Daani-Jaanera yuuyidi Sidoona bida.
Qasse Xiroose miixa, Hiiweta katamatanne Kanaaneta katamata, wurseththan Yuhudappe dugeha baggara diza Bersaabehe bida.
Biittayo uddufun aginanne nam7u tammu gallas ubbaa yuuyi xeellidaappe guye Yerusalaame simmida.
Iyo7aabey ola asaa qooda ubbaa kawoza erisides; Isra7eelen 800,000 Yuhudan 500,000 mashsha shoddi olettana dandayzati beettida.

Dawiti olanchchata qoodidaappe guye ba wozinara modhettidi, «Ta gita nagara ooththadis; ha7ikka GODAWU! Tana ne aylleza ne maarana mala ta nena woossays; ha7ikka GODAWU tani ne aylley gita bala ooso ooththida gishshas maararkkii?» gides.
Wonteththa gallas Dawiti dendanaappe sinththan GODAA qaalay Dawites ajjuuta yootiza nabey Gaadekko yiidi,
«Baada Dawites, ‹GODAY nena isttafe issiniyo doorana mala heedzdzu yo7ota shiishshadis; ta ne bolla ooththana mala issiniyo doora› gides» gaada yoota.

Gaadey Dawitekko biidi, «Ne biitta bolla heedzdzu layththa koshay yo gay? Woykko ne morkketi nena heedzdzu agina gakkanaas gooddiin baqatana koyay? Woykko ne biitta bolla heedzdzu gallas kumeth iita hargey yo gay? Hessa gishshas tana kiittidayssas ta ay zaaro immanaakko qoppa» gides.
Dawiti Gaades, «Tani keeha ceecadis; iza maaroteththay gita gidida gishshas GODAA kushen nu kundana attiin ta asa kushen kundike» gides.
Hessa gishshas GODAY he gallassa maaladoppe doommidi ba barida gallas gakkanaas Isra7eele bolla iita harge yeddides; hessa gaason Daaneppe biidi Bersaabehe gakkanaas 70,000 asi wurides.

GODAA kiitanchchay Yerusalaame dippi histtidi dhayssanaas ba kushe yeddiin asaa bolla gakkida qohoy GODAA qadheththides; histtiin dereza wursiza kiitanchchaza, «Gidana! Agga!» gides. He wode GODAA kiitanchchay Yaabuse dere as Orna bale achchan eqqi dees.

Dawiti dereza bolla bosha gaththiza kiitanchchaza be7idi GODAAS, «Nagara ooththiday tana, balettiday tana; hayti gidikko dorsata; istti ay mooridoo? Ne kushey ta bollanne ta keeththa bolla gido» gides.
Dawiti Giigsida Yarshizaso
He gallas Gaadey Dawitekko biidi, «Pude Yaabuse dere as Orna bale kezada GODAAS yarsho yarshanaaso giigsa» gides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti GODAY Gaade baggara izas azazida mala kezides.
Ornay duge simmi xeellishin kawozinne iza derezi baakko yizayssa be7ides; izi kare kezidi izas biitta bolla hokki ziggides.
Ornaykka, «Kawoo! Ta godawu taakko intte ayllezakko ays yidetii?» gides. Dawiti zaaridi, «Deraa bolla yaana boshay simmana mala GODAAS yarsho yarshizaso giigsanaas ne baleza shammana yadis» gides.
Ornaykka Dawites, «Kawoy! Ta goday bana lo7idayssa ekkidi yarsho shiishsho; xuugettiza yarshos boorati deettes; eeso miththas kath bukkiza lodanne boora qambaray dees.
Kawoo! Tani Ornay hayssa ubbaa kawos immays» gides; qasseka Ornay, «GODAA ne Xoossay neekko xeello» gides.

Kawozi gidikko Ornas, «Hessaththo hanoppo; waagaza ta nees qanxxana bessees. GODAA ta Xoossaas miishshe qanxxontta yarsho shiishshike» gides. Hessa gishshas Dawiti balezanne boorata 50 saqilen shammides.
Heen Dawiti yarsho yarshizaso giigsides; xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa yarsho yarshides; hessafe guye GODAY biittay gishshas shiiqida woosaa siyides. Isra7eele bolla yida boshazi simmides.
